verdict.rationale: Decagon offers pieces of event-driven automation — Watchtower flags conversations based on natural-language-defined criteria, proactive agents trigger recommendations/calls based on customer signals, and AOPs let teams define agent behavior in natural language similar to SOPs — but there's no documented general-purpose rule engine where a user explicitly defines 'on event X, do action Y' outside these narrow product surfaces. Missing for 10: an explicit rules/trigger builder spanning arbitrary events and actions, technical documentation on trigger conditions/logic, and independent verification that these features work as a flexible automation framework rather than fixed product modules.
